cases.name: momentum-synthetic-dated-divergence
cases.reading: Harbor's measured rebounding profile is strong while its coverage leans cautious, creating a tension between performance and mood. Statistical distinctiveness increased by eight points over the last two days, whereas coverage tone decreased by twelve points in a similar window; neither change proves a causal link between the two.
review: Explain the dated change in statistical distinctiveness without calling it skill improvement.
Preserve two-observation sample and different coverage/performance dimensions; missing peer is unknown.
